closure_policy.mechanism: Session 2 captures the final verified Checkpoint (checkpoint --final); the single-writer lease is then released and the final Handoff published via interrupt as an orchestrator recovery step because Session 2 ended without a deliberate pause; validate and complete are never invoked
closure_policy.rationale: completeRun would create Evidence-bound completion, mark the Work Item completed, and ship the backlog source, all forbidden by the MI-005 contract truthful_closure_rule and F11; the engine offers no other Level-5-only terminal state, so the final verified Checkpoint is the operational closure record. Per lease_policy the lease is released "by recovery after unexpected stop": Session 2 ended without deliberate pause leaving the lease held, so the orchestrator performed the recovery lease-release (interrupt --session-id session-mi005-2), which released the lease and published the final Handoff referencing run-mi005-final-2 with no Work completion, backlog change, or Evidence.

cutover_and_drain.drain_rule: the current journal at the Git common directory journal/ path remains the sole authority for its existing Runs; MI-005 performs zero writes under the journal path.
cutover_and_drain.dual_writer_prohibition: DUAL_RUN_ROUTE_CONFLICT before any mutation if a current-journal or target dual Run exists for the effort.
cutover_and_drain.new_run_cutover: run-mi005 is a new target Run with a new identity, created only in the target operational store; no current journal Run is imported, converted, or re-keyed.

effect_key_policy.completed_replay: deduplicated without re-execution and without rewriting the record
effect_key_policy.retry: only for effects classified retryable and only under the same effect key

sole_material_effect.content: MI-005 resumable run cutover keyed effect completed exactly once.
sole_material_effect.effort_implementation_effects: prohibited (the effort is already implemented and published)

effect_key_policy.unknown_blocks: UNKNOWN_EFFECT_BLOCKS_RETRY until explicitly reconciled by the human

lease_policy.acquisition: at start or at resume after freshness validation passes
lease_policy.dead_process_reclamation: same-host only, with staleness check, recorded in audit ledger
lease_policy.journal_lease_isolation: no lease is ever taken on or copied from any current journal Run

level_6_guarantees: ABSENT — no Work completion, Assurance Plan, Guard, Waiver, Decision, Learning, or Level 6 state is created or claimed.

sharing_boundary.resume_source: only a verified immutable Checkpoint plus a published Handoff, with no transcript dependency

target_route.role: MI-005 creates the first target Run for this effort's target route; it never re-implements, mutates, or completes the effort.
